title: El bote de las luces: un solo cielo
description: docs/animas/README.md § The jar, § The jar as one sky, src/jar-ui.ts. The jar at home opens as a window over the living room: one sky with every ánima's constellation open at once (Gerard's tree on the left, Aitor's on the right, the shared ones small and scattered between, with what they have learned as small stars), the dúos mayores as gold stars between two constellations (after Aurelià, a «?» until both ends are lit), and the jar below with every eco. Here with all seven ánimas, after Aurelià. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: localStorage.removeItem('gerard35.ecos.v1'); localStorage.setItem('gerard35.jar-stage.v1', '2'); window.gerard.story.merge(['aurelia', 'luz-aurelia']); window.gerard.story.clearImprovements(); window.gerard.story.debugEcos = 24; window.gerard.story.debugAnimas = { matemagico: 1, papagato: 3, tecnopata: 1, dadaista: 7, sincopante: 1, prismatico: 2, freatica: 1 }; window.jar = window.gerard.jarUI; window.node = id => document.querySelector(`[data-improve="${id}"]`)

steps.caption: The jar on the dining table and the prompt Abrir el bote
Opening: the window rises out of the jar over the living room (it never takes the whole screen)

The one sky with all seven ánimas after Aurelià (grade III in it), nothing lit yet: Matemágico on the left and Tecnópata on the right, whole; Dadista, Sincopante, Papagato, Colorista and Freática small and scattered round and between them, each with its Maná +1 and its definitiva, and what it has learned fighting as small stars of its colour; Vulcano a «?» of dim gold between Matemágico's fire and Sincopante. Gerard's cursor on his core pushes Matemágico in a little
Moving over the whole sky by nearest star: on a node, the floating note says what it is, what it does, what it costs and what pressing would do
Turning a node on: a light leaves the jar, crosses the sky and lands; the node becomes a pane of lit glass and its join lights
Combustión lit, the top of the fire line, held still a moment after: Sincopante's Ostinato is already learned, so both sides have reached Vulcano and a light runs along each thread towards its «?»
A second later the «?» opens as Vulcano, swelling bright before it settles; Ostinato's name comes out over its star, and the note moves off so as not to hide it

Vulcano, the first dúo mayor, between Matemágico's fire and Sincopante: gold, larger, ringed, threaded to Combustión and to Ostinato (whose name now always shows). Its note names both halves and what it does; 2 ecos to wake it. Both constellations are pushed in on
Waking Vulcano: two lights fly from the jar and its threads burn gold

Both at work at once: Gerard on Vulcano, Aitor inside Tecnópata (Mente lit as far as Control remoto, his cursor on it). Two notes, each edged in its player's colour and threaded to its light; each constellation under a cursor pushed in

Aitor jumps to a shared ánima with Q/E: Dadista at level 7 is pushed in on and the names of what it has learned come out beside its small stars; its note lists them, with its Maná +1, Otra vez and its definitiva as nodes
Turning Rescoldo off takes Combustión and Vulcano with it: each light flies back to the jar and the dúo mayor goes back to a «?», its threads faint
Without Combustión Vulcano is a «?» again: no name, nothing of its halves
Closing: the window folds back down into the jar and the room is theirs again
The status screen's Ánimas page: Matemágico shows no level, its bought skills in the list and its passives under Con ecos de luz
